notes: Operational guidance confirmed directly by the RHUB team. It explains how the documented API contracts are used together; it does not change any contract. Kept separate from RHUB_FULL_SOURCE_EXPORT.json so the original documentation export is never rewritten. Update this file and re-run tools/generate.py to refresh the guidance shown on the public pages.

customerPaths.label: Existing customer
customerPaths.summary: The customer has already been registered with RHUB.
customerPaths.action: Use the existing customer code for the transaction. Do not register the customer again.

customerPaths.label: New customer, registered before payout
customerPaths.summary: The customer is not yet known to RHUB and you want to register them as a separate step.
customerPaths.action: Register the customer with the Customer Registration API, then use the resulting customer code for the payout.

customerPaths.label: New customer, registered on the fly
customerPaths.summary: The customer is not yet known to RHUB and you want to register them as part of the payout.
customerPaths.action: RHUB supports customer registration as part of the Payout flow. A separate Customer Registration call is not required on this path; the Payout fields governing it (for example isAutoRegistered, declaration and the sender details) remain exactly as the Payout contract defines them.

customerNote: Customer Registration is not a mandatory standalone call before every payout. Which of the three paths applies depends on whether the customer is already registered and how you choose to register new customers.

documentModel.purpose: Customer verification — KYC for individual customers, KYB for business customers.

documentModel.requirement: Mandatory for B2B, B2C and C2B payout processing. Not applicable as an invoice requirement to C2C.

transactionMatrix.invoice: Not applicable as an invoice requirement

payoutPrerequisites: Authenticate and obtain an access token.
Determine customer status: use the existing customer code, or pre-register the customer, or use the supported on-the-fly registration path in the Payout request.
Ensure the required KYC/KYB documentation has been uploaded and the applicable `docReferenceNumber` is available.
For B2B, B2C and C2B, ensure the required invoice documentation is available and the applicable `sendClientTrxReference` value is used.
Obtain the master, reference, bank or validation data your route and use case require — only the ones you actually need, not every master API.

openQuestions.topic: C2C value for the Mandatory invoice reference field
openQuestions.question: The Payout contract marks `sendClientTrxReference` as Mandatory at transactionInfo level, while the confirmed invoice-document requirement applies only to B2B, B2C and C2B. The expected value or usage for C2C payouts is not established.

fieldNaming.note:
The Payout request field table renders the invoice reference across two lines because the source cell contains a line break (sendClient
TrxReference). The field identifier is sendClientTrxReference, as the Payout request example writes it. The contract table is reproduced unchanged; prose and guidance use the identifier.
